videoram.description: Total size of video memory in kilobytes.

buffermem.description: Size of reserved video memory in kilobytes.

format.description: TV signal format code. See comments for mapping (e.g., 1=NTSC-M, 3=PAL-B/G/I, etc.). Set to 0 to leave commented/unset.

i2c_mode.description: I2C interface mode. Set to 0 to leave commented/unset. Valid values: 1–5 (see comments).
